keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Penalty missed! Still Aston Villa 0, Fulham 0. John McGinn (Aston Villa) hits the bar with a left footed shot.
David Affengruber (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Aston Villa 1, Fulham 0. Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Johan Manzambi.
Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Aston Villa 1, Fulham 0.
Own Goal by Zion Suzuki, Aston Villa. Aston Villa 1, Fulham 1.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Ibrahim Mbaye replaces Leon Goretzka.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Emiliano Buendía replaces Alysson.
Substitution, Aston Villa. João Gomes replaces Johan Manzambi.
Substitution, Fulham. Tom Cairney replaces Alex Iwobi.
Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tom Cairney (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Fulham. Kenny Tete replaces Oscar Bobb.
Substitution, Fulham. César Palacios replaces Josh King.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Ross Barkley replaces Boubacar Kamara.
Substitution, Fulham. Rodrigo Muniz replaces Gonzalo García.
Substitution, Fulham. Hugo Larsson replaces Timothy Castagne.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Alejandro Garnacho replaces John McGinn.
Second Half ends, Aston Villa 1, Fulham 1.
